Implementation uses httpx.Timeout(read=...) which is architecturally correct for read-timeout semantics. test_continuous_stream_not_killed passes, verifying continuous streams are not killed. However, test_silent_stream_raises_timeout is SKIPPED, not passed. A skipped test is an ABSENT verdict per absence-of-failure-is-not-success.md. Cannot independently verify that silent streams raise timeout as specified by ASSUM-009.

Work exists on disk but cannot be merged because it's not persisted in version control. This is a critical blocker.
